closed_findings.title: Renderer imported an absent parser alias

closed_findings.fix: Use the existing _ephemeral_storage adapter through the intended alias.

closed_findings.title: Small parsed landing arrays failed reader cleanup
closed_findings.proof: The native parser keeps small arrays as lists; closing(iter(list)) raised AttributeError for default empty landing records.
closed_findings.fix: The private _reader context closes only closeable iterators and retains cleanup failures correctly.

closed_findings.title: Writable live events could render semantics different from the sealed export
closed_findings.proof: A normal indexed event-type write changed sealed BOUNCE to a rendered UNKNOWN_EVENT while both actual video codecs and final seal succeeded.
closed_findings.fix: Stream-compare live physical events to pinned match_events and capture the owner change token before comparison; retain that exact token before and after every frame and final checks.
closed_findings.restore_equal_case: Normal changed-and-restored writes advanced generation 6 to 8 and were rejected with closed source/writer handles, no final seal and unchanged exports/base.

closed_findings.title: One unusable display projection aborted an otherwise recoverable video
closed_findings.proof: A finite invertible frame-9 matrix crossed the court horizon; another same-hemisphere matrix exceeded OpenCV coordinate representation. Semantic exports had succeeded before the renderer aborted.
closed_findings.baseline_limitation: The overflow baseline application pins were stable but test_corrected_rendering.py changed during the run; that receipt correctly reports source_stable=False. Both final closure receipts are fully source-stable.
closed_findings.fix: Admit whole-court and retained landmark display projection separately from source qualification, withhold only known unusable display geometry and reset continuity; retain source matrices and accepted rules.
closed_findings.executed_closure: Both cases fully decode source/native/browser at 12/12/12, withhold frame 9 with an explicit reason, and restore court drawing on frame 10.
